flags.group: The brief's two High-confidence tests conflict
flags.title: ‘Greater than 70% chance’ and ‘priced between −250 and +10,000’ overlap only in the 70.0–71.4% sliver
flags.detail: A 70% chance is a fair price of −233; −250 is a 71.4% chance; anything above 71.4% prices shorter than −250 and leaves the band. This desk keeps the band as the hard filter and publishes the probability on every row so a stricter cut can be applied by the reader. The grade rules are spelled out on the Methodology page.

flags.group: No official injury feed could be captured for any sport
flags.title: Injury analysis is a stated requirement and is not delivered today
flags.detail: None of the official sources we captured publish a machine-readable availability report at the time of capture for these fixtures: the NHL and MLB publish rosters but not a status feed with an injury list, and the club-level reports are published as PDFs behind dynamic pages. Every prediction therefore says plainly that no injury claim is made, rather than guessing at a lineup.
